'''Burgo Teage''' was a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[black marketeer]] who dealt with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He attempted to make a deal with [[Gaen Drommel]] to provide [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] parts for the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']], but was thwarted on [[Vohai]] by two [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]-allied ship thieves, [[Cryle Cavv]] and [[Sienn Sconn]].
